questions.stem: Why is aluminium more expensive than iron, even though aluminium ore is more abundant?

options.text: Iron is easier to find underground
Aluminium requires electrolysis, which uses large amounts of expensive electrical energy
Aluminium is heavier and harder to transport
Iron can be extracted by electrolysis, which is cheaper

questions.explanation: Aluminium is above carbon in the reactivity series, so it must be extracted by electrolysis, which requires very large amounts of electrical energy and is expensive. Iron is below carbon and can be extracted by the much cheaper method of reduction with carbon in a blast furnace.
